mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS observations fail to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5 triggers positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases during the observation period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 2200 and RSAFS > 340000 triggers negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 120 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing strength, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 120 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strong economic momentum, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth above 2.0% quarterly fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0 triggers positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 132000 and UNRATE < 5.0 triggers negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 110 (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 110 triggers positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
